scenes.scene_title: Chef's Gourmet Kitchen & Dining 360-Degree Orbital Sweep
scenes.prompt: Mind-blowing 16:9 photorealistic 360-degree orbital micro-drone sweep around luxury villa kitchen island counter (07_villa_kitchen_dining.jpg). Smooth steadycam arc highlighting sleek black marble island, designer bar stools, warm sparkling pendant lights, and fresh steaming espresso coffee. Camera glides gracefully toward the floor-to-ceiling glass sliding patio door (05_sliding_door_close.jpg). Photorealistic 8K architecture photography, zero text, hyper-attractive visual.

scenes.transition: High-velocity speed-ramp acceleration towards the sliding patio glass door

scenes.scene_title: Sliding Door Macro Opening & Outdoor Pool Deck Reveal
scenes.prompt: Sensational 2-stage photorealistic transition: Macro close-up on sleek black aluminum sliding glass door handle (05_sliding_door_close.jpg) as it smoothly glides open to the right with sunlight glittering off clear glass reflections. Camera immediately bursts through the open doorway, soaring low across the sunlit teak pool deck (06_outside_our_villa.jpg) past luxury sun loungers, manicured lawn, and tropical palm trees. 16:9, photorealistic 8K, pure visual brilliance.

scenes.transition: Low-angle speed glide over the swimming pool water surface

scenes.scene_title: Pool Water Ripple Macro to Grand Satellite Sunset Ascent Finale
scenes.prompt: Mind-blowing finale sequence: Ultra-low camera hover over infinity pool water surface (11_villa_pool_water_close.jpg) capturing slow-motion water ripples reflecting sunset sky. Suddenly, camera shoots vertically like a rocket, climbing straight up to 60 meters altitude for a 360° estate overview (08_villa_drone_view.jpg), and continuously accelerating up into a 5,000m high-altitude photorealistic Google Earth 3D satellite map view of the entire tropical island coastline, ocean reefs, and golden hour sunset horizon. Pure cinematic 8K satellite finale, zero text, 16:9, ultimate video conclusion.
